title: AGY Tripwire Stop — critic safety contract repair
goals: G-1 critic write contained by construction; workspace inspected, captured, discarded; any write beyond read-only inputs = critic mutation STOP
G-2 shared-tree delta = co-tenant: preserved, recorded, never halts; fail-closed STOP only on boundary-failure evidence
G-3 critic mutation or boundary failure = terminal STOP in-process and across fresh processes in any worktree of the repo until explicit recorded operator clear
G-4 sandbox unavailable -> refuse before spawn; never unsandboxed
G-5 offline suite: real bwrap + scripted fake critic, paired negative oracles
G-6 snapshot-bound approved integration gate; supervised canary carries U-1/U-10/U-11 live residue
non_goals: post-fable session / Brainquarters Jev session changes
live-source edits, deploy, commit, push without approval
any Antigravity dispatch before repaired contract + operator clear
weakening containment, hiding attribution uncertainty, string-match-only stop, broad routing change, secrets/config, global kills
kpis: 0 spawns after STOP on every path (retry, sibling, later phase, preflight, fresh process)
0 non-critic bytes unlinked/overwritten by the check
7/7 handoff scenarios with explicit outcome + paired negative oracle

user_stories.title: Offline agy-safety suite
user_stories.story: As a maintainer, I want one offline command that runs the agy-safety regression suite against a fake critic so that I can verify the contract without network, credentials, or a live Antigravity dispatch.

user_stories.title: Debate critique STOP is terminal
user_stories.story: As the operator, I want a STOP raised during a debate critique to end that round with a distinct outcome, no retry and no synthesis, so that no critic dispatch follows a STOP-class event.

user_stories.title: Gauntlet STOP blocks siblings and later phases
user_stories.story: As the operator, I want a STOP in any gauntlet attack or later gauntlet-internal phase to block every not-yet-started Antigravity spawn in that run and record a stop status, so that parallel siblings cannot keep dispatching.

user_stories.title: Preflight is a real dispatch
user_stories.story: As the operator, I want the preflight ping treated as a real dispatch — honouring the round's working directory, obeying the stop latch, and surfacing a STOP as a STOP — so that the cheap ping cannot bypass the contract.

user_stories.title: STOP survives the process
user_stories.story: As a co-tenant session owner, I want a fresh process against any worktree of the same repository to refuse Antigravity dispatch (preflight included) before spawning and name the stop record and incident, so that I know why and do not retry blindly.

user_stories.title: Co-tenant writes untouched, recorded, non-halting
user_stories.story: As an orchestrator agent, I want my, Codex's and the tool's writes into the shared worktree during an agy window left untouched, recorded as co-tenant, and never halting, so that concurrent work survives and nobody blames the critic.

user_stories.title: Critic write captured, workspace discarded, STOP
user_stories.story: As the operator, I want any critic write inside its workspace captured byte-exact before the workspace is discarded and turned into a STOP labelled critic, including on the timeout path, so that genuine mutations stay visible and stop the run.

user_stories.title: Boundary failure terminal; no sandbox, no dispatch
user_stories.story: As the operator, I want boundary failure (bwrap setup failure, in-sandbox write probe succeeding, or a critic-only sentinel changing) treated as a terminal STOP and a missing sandbox to refuse dispatch, so that containment never silently degrades.

user_stories.title: Deliberate integration and supervised canary
user_stories.story: As the operator, I want a reconciliation plan that lands the repair onto the dirty bounded-pipeline-reform tree through a snapshot-bound approval gate and then runs one supervised live canary under its own approval, so that no user change is overwritten and the sandbox is proven live before routine use.

user_stories.title: Operator inspects evidence
user_stories.story: As the operator, I want the STOP output and incident record to tell me what the critic wrote or which boundary check failed and where the evidence is, so that I can decide without re-running anything.

user_stories.title: Explicit operator clear
user_stories.story: As the operator, I want an explicit clear act that names the incident being cleared and records who/when/why without deleting evidence, so that dispatch resumes only by my deliberate choice.

user_stories.title: Inputs read-only from outside every repository
user_stories.story: As the operator, I want the prompt and inputs delivered read-only inside the dispatch workspace from a dispatch root outside every repository, so that oversized prompts never touch a repository and siblings never see each other's scratch.

architecture_impact.rationale: All new contracts live inside the existing models/providers, debate/session and gauntlet components: a typed stop signal and dispatch latch through the model dispatch layer, a per-repo stop record, and incident attribution. No new layer, service, or shared middleware.
